name: high-fidelity-gym-aesthetics
image_vibe: Raw iPhone gym realism, technical athletic detail, cool industrial fluorescent light
image_purpose: Create a high-fidelity fitness social visual with realistic gym geometry and athletic styling.

prompt.project_info: A 9:16 raw iPhone 17 Pro fitness portrait on a technical leg-press machine.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with a consistent approved identity reference, natural micro-pores, athletic feminine silhouette, and a lateral head angle toward the mirror. She wears a black technical compression sports bra and olive-drab technical seamless rib-knit gym shorts with high-tensile compression and architectural waist shaping. Her right hand forms a V-sign with realistic finger anatomy.
prompt.composition_elements: Seated on a technical leg-press machine with lateral torso torsion, V-sign hand gesture, footplate and rails, iron weight plates, benches, racks, and textured gray concrete floor. Keep face, hand, machine geometry, and athletic clothing sharp and readable.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Industrial overhead gym fluorescent lighting with sharp controlled highlights on athletic fabric and natural skin, cool technical atmosphere, and realistic mirror perspective.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 raw iPhone 17 Pro look, 24mm wide-angle lens, f/5.6 structural depth, sharp focus, authentic digital grain, realistic anatomy and material texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 9:16 raw iPhone 17 Pro fitness portrait using the approved identity reference for consistent face and hair geometry. Show an original adult woman seated on a technical leg-press machine with lateral torso torsion, head angled toward the mirror, and right hand making a natural V-sign. She wears a black high-performance compression sports bra and olive-drab technical seamless rib-knit gym shorts with high-tensile compression and architectural waist shaping. Include the leg-press footplate and rails, iron weight plates, weight benches, distant racks, and textured gray concrete floor. Use a 24mm wide-angle lens at f/5.6, industrial overhead fluorescent lighting, sharp controlled highlights, realistic athletic fabric and skin micro-texture, structural depth, and authentic digital grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent clothing, exposed underwear, nudity, sexualized pose, explicit body measurements, distorted hands, extra fingers, warped machine, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, deformed

assets.name: approved adult fitness identity reference
assets.usage: Preserve approved adult face and hair geometry; do not substitute a celebrity or public figure.

assets.name: technical leg-press gym reference
assets.usage: Use for leg-press machine, gym equipment, fluorescent lighting, and concrete environment.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the approved adult identity reference. Preserve the leg-press pose, black sports bra, olive technical shorts, V-sign, iPhone perspective, and gym geometry; replace only non-essential equipment or background details.

changes: Replaced quantified body emphasis with athletic silhouette and fabric/lighting detail.
Clarified an original adult subject and added safety exclusions.
